services.name: RV Sites
services.desc: Up to 5 people included in each RV site. $5/person/night after the first 5 people up to a maximum of 10 people. Potomac Riverview RV site offers a great view of the Potomac and close access to our boat ramp. 30/50 amp with water & electric. Price is the same as full hook up sites. Driver must be comfortable backing up. RV campers who wish to check in BEFORE 2pm or check out AFTER 11am, may do so for a $25 fee. This option is based on site availability. services.name: Brunswick Family Campground
services.desc: Tent camping for individuals is available in Nottingham Woods with designated sites, in Potomac Green in a general camping area, or in one of our group sites. Access to hot showers, bathrooms, picnic tables, fire pits, and running water are available within walking distance. Two night camping minimums apply on Fri & Sat for Nottingham Woods and Group Sites. We have six basic cabins available at the Brunswick Family campground. Two cabins on the Potomac River, and four tucked in the woods at the edge of our campground. Custom-built are a perfect upgrade from tent camping! For more info visit our River & Trail website Harpers Ferry cabin page. 55 RV sites with 30 or 50 amp electrical service
